# Sonnatt.ai

> Sonnatt.ai gives Leeds and Bradford businesses one dedicated account manager who builds and runs their website, chatbot, custom apps and marketing. A real team does the work and uses AI to move quickly. Based in Leeds, West Yorkshire.

## Key facts
- Setup: £995 one-off (discovery and strategy session, website and chatbot built and live, connected to existing systems, team training).
- Ongoing: £995 a month for single-site businesses, cancel any time (hosting and running costs, marketing and social media management, monthly review call, priority support).
- Sonnatt Scale: from £3,000 a month, scoped after discovery, for multiple sites, locations and system integrations.
- Services: website build and hosting, chatbot and systems, marketing and social growth, custom apps, workflow automation, ongoing support.
- Who it is for: letting and property management, accountants and advisers, clinics and practices, salons, gyms and venues, trades and contractors.
- Area: Leeds and Bradford, West Yorkshire, UK.
- Contact: info@sonnattai.com, or the form at https://sonnattai.com/#contact (free 15-minute walkthrough).
- The presenter "Emma" in the site's introduction video is AI-generated, and the website chatbot is an AI assistant.
